description:
Deploy a Clarity smart contract to the Stacks blockchain.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

contractName.description: Unique name for the contract (lowercase, hyphens allowed)

fee.description: Optional fee: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' preset or micro-STX amount. Clamped to 50,000 uSTX max for deployments. If omitted, medium-priority fee is auto-resolved. Ignored when sponsored=true.

sponsored.description: Use sponsored transaction relay so a relay service pays fees instead of your wallet. Requires SPONSOR_API_KEY env var or wallet-level sponsorApiKey.

name: deploy_contract
